messages:
Maya: Heads up 11am visitor: my grandma is in town and swinging by at 11:30. She uses a walker and wants a quiet spot to sit. Also a courier just left a boxed instrument (looks fragile) at Returns Shelf A1 addressed to 'Live Demos' but no sender sticker. Any preferences on seating? Quiet corner by the library or the high-top near kitchen?
Nora: Quiet corner for sure. Less foot traffic and easier for a walker. Do we have a step-free route from reception?
Alex (facilities): Route is fine 11:30. I'll put out a folding chair and a small side table in the quiet corner. Can also mark the path with a mat if needed.
Diego (reception): I can pre-print a visitor badge 11:15 check-in. If they need a wheelchair-accessible door code, we can disable the turnstile temporarily. I can also accept the instrument and tag it fragile.
Priya: If Diego can tag the instrument, please note "DO NOT STACK" on the label. Also happy to bring a travel blanket for the chair if that helps grandma be comfy.
Sam: Re: package 11. I think "Live Demos" is Kian's team. Kian's OOO today but I can DM him.
MailBot: Package scanned: "BlueLine Logistics" 10:42am 12. Location: Returns Shelf A1. Item: 1x "case (fragile)". No recipient on barcode. Claim within 72h or transfer to secure storage. (automated)
Maya: Thanks all. Diego 11:15 pre-print works great. Alex 11:25 if you could put the mat that'd be perfect. Sam 10:42 please ping Kian; if not claimed I'll move it to Secure Storage labeled "Live Demos - fragile".
Alex (facilities): Done 11:24 14 mat down, chair & table placed. Left an accessibility route note on the front-of-house instructions.
Diego (reception): Badge queued under "Maya - guest". Leaving note: "walker, quiet corner". Will ring when guest checks in.
Nora: Sending a quick voice note with directions to Maya. Also bringing tea. :tea:
Sam: DMed Kian about the instrument. If no reply by noon I'll move to Secure Storage and add a slack ping to #eng-ops.
Maya: Grandma arriving a little early 11:20. Thanks everyone 12 for the blanket & tea. Appreciate the quick coord. :heart:
